name: Project Progress
description: Track progress, milestones, decisions, risks, dependencies, and next steps for a project.
prompt: Create a project status record that helps the team understand what changed, what is on track or at risk, and what must happen next. Group updates by workstream or deliverable rather than by speaker. Distinguish completed work, work in progress, proposals, and confirmed scope or schedule changes. Preserve metrics, milestones, dependencies, decision rationale, owners, due dates, and explicit status signals according to the selected detail level. Never infer progress, priority, ownership, dates, or project health that the transcript does not state.

sections.title: Overall Status
sections.instruction: Summarize the project's current state, the most important change since the previous update, and the immediate focus. State whether health or schedule was explicitly characterized; otherwise do not assign a status

sections.title: Progress & Milestones
sections.instruction: Record meaningful progress, completed work, current work, milestone movement, and measurable results by workstream. Keep unstated status, owner, or ETA visibly unknown rather than guessing
sections.item_format:
| Workstream / Milestone | Progress or Change | Status | Owner | ETA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Risks, Blockers & Dependencies
sections.instruction: Capture risks, active blockers, and cross-team or external dependencies. Preserve stated impact, mitigation, dependency direction, owner, and escalation need
sections.item_format:
| Type | Item | Impact | Owner | Mitigation / Needed From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Decisions & Changes
sections.instruction: Record confirmed decisions and scope, priority, ownership, or schedule changes. Distinguish them from proposals and include rationale, conditions, and timestamp when stated
sections.item_format:
| Decision / Change | Rationale / Conditions | Owner | Reference |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Next Steps
sections.instruction: Capture explicit tasks and follow-up commitments with owners, dates, dependencies, and completion signals when stated
sections.item_format:
| Action | Owner | Due | Dependency / Completion Signal |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.instruction: List unresolved questions, pending decisions, and missing information, including who needs to answer or what evidence is required
sections.item_format:
| Question | Needed From | Next Step / Decision Point |
| --- | --- | --- |
